description: Fetch a web page server-side (SSRF-guarded) and return every element matching a CSS selector as structured JSON: text content, attributes and HTML. Deterministic extraction for agents that need specific parts of a page without reading the whole document. Use this when an agent needs to fetch a page and extract elements matching a CSS selector. x402 price $0.005/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: dev_scrape_selector
title: CSS Selector Scraper
